title: A niche and an identity
header_line: Jose's analysis of a book we are still naming. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: How narrow is the thing you want to be known for?

Jose said that if you want to become an expert in a field, you pick one particular thing. He said that his own is a very small niche in the world of real estate, which has dozens of businesses. A specific niche attracts specific people.
He said that he wears different hats, such as teacher or investment banker, and has to be careful not to mix the different hats, identities, brands and messages.

Jose used the film character who is a professor in the classroom and becomes an adventurer when he packs his bag. He said that in this book you will develop a solid identity of who you are, so that you can attract people to you.
A student said: I like what the introduction says about leading from out front, not from behind. Jose said: being visible.

Jose said that he believes in servant leadership. As a teacher you are a servant to your students: you learn collaboratively with them and help them discover who they are, and you are a follower of them.
What is the one hat you will wear in public?

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write the many hats you wear.
Write the one that you want to be known for.
Write how you keep the messages apart.
Write what visible means for you.
Write how you are a servant to the people you lead.

check.q: What did Jose say about hats?
choices: Do not mix the different hats and messages

check.q: What did a student say the introduction says about leading?
What did Jose say a teacher is?

recap: Pick a narrow niche. Be visible. Serve the people you lead.
